required_documents.name: Real-time Merchant & Bank API Syncs
required_documents.description: Continuous automated pipeline mapping raw receipts, churn velocity, and transactional net margins.

required_documents.name: Live MRR/ARR Subscription Report
required_documents.description: Detailed breakdowns of monthly recurring revenues, expansion MRR, contract-weighted durations, and net revenue retention indexes.

required_documents.name: Quality of Earnings (QofE) Report
required_documents.description: Independent third-party financial review analyzing structural sustainability of EBITDA calculations and enterprise billing patterns.

required_documents.name: Cohort Retention Matrix & Cap Table
required_documents.description: Month-by-month customer retention cohorts alongside fully-diluted ownership summaries (common, preferred, options, warrants).

required_documents.name: 3-Year Corporate Tax Returns
required_documents.description: IRS-submitted business tax returns for the past three fiscal years, fully signed, including all associated schedules and K-1 distributions.

required_documents.name: Personal Financial Statements & Guarantees
required_documents.description: Detailed disclosures of liquid assets, real estate holdings, outstanding liabilities, and personal net worth schedules for any shareholder with >20% ownership.

required_documents.name: Historical P&L & Balance Sheet Statements
required_documents.description: Standard accrual-basis profit and loss statements paired with historical balance sheets.

disqualification_triggers: SaaS recurring revenue contribution falls below 60% of gross intake
API links disconnected for more than 48 consecutive hours
Average transactional chargebacks exceed 1.5% of gross volume
Uncapped senior secured liens discovered on intellectual property assets
Active warrant coverage adjustments drop below structural baseline (0.5%)
Negative cash runway drops below 6 months without institutional co-investor backing
Principal shareholder bankruptcy, unresolved tax lien, or pending federal litigation
Inability to provide absolute personal real estate deeds or personal asset guarantees
Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) falls below the standard SBA statutory limit of 1.15x
